no notch and no tab in any of the four traces.

list row 1, tile BRAINDANCE, badge T2, REPORT SPAM,
NEXT, and card 1 down through its values row.

roles; some trace runs use local sampled inks.

rescale, not to a designed stroke or shadow.

g.text: rest: outline 2, closed glyph; title 22.25 / FROM 16.25, both medium. Sourced.
hover: solid #a6d2a8 flush, ink #25281d. Sourced as the cursor fill (mail row 1,
which is not the open row). One fill per group; it moves with the pointer.
press: the fill drops while held, the cell reads as rest; fill returns on release. Inferred.
open: outline, sage ink, OPEN glyph 17x16 at +18,+17. Sourced, mail row 2. The panel carries its strings.
rest: 188x52, stroke 2 #709174, label medium 23.5 x1.03 #a6d2a8 at +21, baseline +24.5. Sourced, REPLY / FORWARD / DELETE.
hover: solid #a6d2a8 flush, no outline, ink #25281d. Sourced as the cursor fill: REPORT SPAM, and NEXT on the login (105x33 #8aac8c / #20281c).
press: highlight off while held, reads as rest; fill returns on release. Inferred. Same rule for the nav cell, the hub tile and the T badge:
one cursor fill per group (SMG, BRAINDANCE, T2 are where the photos left it), moving with the pointer, blinking off for a press.
Not in the material and not drawn: a brightened or thickened outline, an underline, an inset ring, a dimmer second fill, a pointer glyph.
Looked at: run-entropism 34..42 whole, and every cell of the four 3840 sources cropped and zoomed. Ghosted glyphs on T1 / T3 / T4 are CRT doubling.
rest: 359x33, stroke 1.25 #75967b, mask regular 25 sx0.94045 at +13.4 baseline +27.25, no caret. Inferred:
the photo shows the field only focused; rest is that frame with the caret off.
hover: solid #8aac8c (the login's fill), no outline, mask in #20281c. Inferred by the
cursor rule; precedent for reverse-video text is the mail title bar.
press: outline back, caret underline 19x0.5 at +13.5, +25.375, held while focused. SOURCED,
login #39: the field as photographed is a pressed field being typed in.
Release lands the destination, never a third look: open glyph, filled title bar, grown card, caret.
